name: Creator Bio Generator
description: Stop sounding like everyone else. Get platform-optimized bios for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and LinkedIn — all from a single input.
seoDescription: Get platform-optimized bios for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, and LinkedIn from a single input. Stop sounding generic — free AI skill.
long_description: Your bio is the first thing a potential follower reads before they decide if you're worth their time. This skill turns Claude or ChatGPT into a creator branding specialist that writes custom bios for every platform you use — each one respecting character limits, platform conventions, and your actual voice. Give it your niche, credentials, and vibe once, and get a complete bio suite that sounds like a real person, not a marketing template. Includes Instagram (150 chars), TikTok (80 chars), Twitter/X (160 chars), LinkedIn headline + summary, and a full YouTube About section.
author: CreatorSkills
